sentences.en: Finally, Tapirus itself, in which the last three upper premolars, makes its appearance in the Upper Miocene, and continues till the present day.

sentences.en: The pachyderms are represented by three species of the peccary (Dicotyles) and two of the anta, or tapir (Tapirus).
